source: Hand-written from native-hello/hello.c, built with `clang -O1 -o hello hello.c` on macOS arm64; verified with `nm -gU`, `nm -u`, `otool -L` and `otool -tV` (clang inlines checksum() and greet() into main, so main calls printf/strlen directly). checksum() is static and not exported. function/call/string facts require a deep provider (Hopper, Ghidra or IDA).
